name: Block Communications
summary: Operational technology communications occur over serial COM, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, cellular (4G/5G), and satellite mediums. Adversaries may block communications to prevent reporting messages and command messages from reaching their intended target devices disrupting processes, operations, and causing cyber-physical impacts. analytics.name: Analytic 2053
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a network infrastructure configuration change that results in a communication gap between previously-connected Industrial Control System (ICS) zones, from a source not in the approved network administration list. This technique-level analytic synthesizes Serial COM (T1695.001), Ethernet (T1695.002), and Wi-Fi (T1695.003). analytics.name: Analytic 2164
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies iptables/nftables rule additions blocking Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol ports on Linux ICS gateways.
